role.roleTitle: Data Analytics Engineer, Equipment Maintenance Services

evidence.text: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks), including the late-arrival handling for telemetry uploaded after a site visit.

Maintained the failure-prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) consumed by the planning team's model, versioning each feature change with a note on the affected machine families.

Recruiter screen: candidate said the planning team told him the model 'now catches about two thirds of failures early, up from maybe half'; he said the numbers were the planning team's, that he had not seen the evaluation, and that several other changes were made to the model in the same period.
evidence.notes: Candidate reported that the planning team mentioned an increase, but the candidate did not see the evaluation or confirm the baseline.

missingEvidence: A measurable increase in failures caught before an unplanned stop against the published baseline

evidence.text: Coordinated schema changes with the planning and platform teams in the fortnightly data review; the platform lead approved warehouse schema changes and the planning lead approved feature changes.

Wrote the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, listing the source tables, the late-arrival rule and the known limitation that machines without a telemetry gateway are absent from the features.
